## MessageSendState Enum

Describes a direct\-message outbox state or a combination of states for filtering\.

```csharp
public enum MessageSendState
```
### Fields

<a name='Meshline.Models.Client.MessageSendState.None'></a>

`None` 0

No send states are selected by the filter\.

<a name='Meshline.Models.Client.MessageSendState.Queued'></a>

`Queued` 1

The message is persisted locally and awaits submission\.

<a name='Meshline.Models.Client.MessageSendState.Submitting'></a>

`Submitting` 2

The message is being submitted to a relay\.

<a name='Meshline.Models.Client.MessageSendState.SubmissionUnknown'></a>

`SubmissionUnknown` 4

Submission was attempted but its acceptance outcome is not yet known\.

<a name='Meshline.Models.Client.MessageSendState.RelayAccepted'></a>

`RelayAccepted` 8

The submitting relay accepted the message for delivery\.

<a name='Meshline.Models.Client.MessageSendState.TargetAccepted'></a>

`TargetAccepted` 16

The destination relay accepted the message; this is not a recipient read receipt\.

<a name='Meshline.Models.Client.MessageSendState.Failed'></a>

`Failed` 32

The outgoing operation failed definitively\.

<a name='Meshline.Models.Client.MessageSendState.Canceled'></a>

`Canceled` 64

The outgoing operation was canceled locally before confirmed relay acceptance\.

<a name='Meshline.Models.Client.MessageSendState.All'></a>
